title: Flaming Snowballs
description: Makes snowballs turn into small fireballs when on fire. Works with flame enchantment.
body: # Description Makes any snowball that's on fire turn into a small fireball (like a dispenser fire charge). It can light fires where it lands. For example, you can light it with fire and lava, and have an infinite supply with a snow golem. Also works with snowballs enchanted with Flame using commands. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same tag, scoreboard or file names.
